title: 性能自检：60fps 预算 / long task / 成画相似度

searched.q: PerformanceObserver longtask 50ms / Long Animation Frames API
searched.takeaway: A long task occupies the main thread ≥50ms. Observe type=longtask (and long-animation-frame when present) after warmup so atlas boot is not counted. RAIL: 50ms task ⇒ input still <100ms.
rAF follows the display. Headless Chrome often delivers ~30Hz, so the 60fps gate is work-per-tick p95 ≤ 16.67ms, not raw rAF count. Measure physics+render with performance.now() inside tick.

searched.q: SSIM Wang 2004 / stipple vs source masked blur compare
searched.takeaway: Formed output is 12k dots on #050505, not a raster of the photo. Blur both crops then SSIM; also correlate RGB histograms of inked pixels. One-shot readback only, never in rAF.
